description: For the starters (tl-product-saas, tl-product-webapp): one PR per framework release vX.Y.Z that raises TrislabFrameworkVersion and @trislabcompany/framework-ui together. In a product repository the template update raises them instead (tl-product-ideas D-40), so this does nothing there.

customManagers.description: The one framework version every Trislab.* NuGet package uses.
The framework's npm package, released with the same version.

packageRules.description: The npm manager can't read GitHub Packages without a token; the regex manager above moves it.
The NuGet manager would see each Trislab.* package on its own; the regex manager above moves them together.
Product repositories take the framework with the template update, never on their own.
